title: Squash Curry Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry with roasted squash and a flavorful curry sauce. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Jamaican Curry Powder
ingredients.notes: or substitute with regular curry powder

instructions: Toss the squash with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a wok or large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted squash and cook for 2-3 minutes, until coated in the curry sauce.
Stir in the soy sauce and brown sugar.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
